observations: Paf/Goldenbull expose one common PowerPlay amount across multiple PowerPlay titles within each snapshot.
The public amounts move materially between cache snapshots, proving the field is dynamic rather than a fixed marketing number.

The closest same-day Paf snapshot (EUR19758) is EUR143.12 below the JOKERBET live Mega observed later that night; this is numerically compatible with roughly two hours of JOKERBET-observed Mega growth but exact crawl time is unavailable.
Unsynchronised cache proximity is not evidence of shared jackpot instance.
requiredBeforeNetworkFingerprintMatch: at least 3 timestamped overlapping Mega snapshots from JOKERBET and candidate source
near-identical absolute amounts at matched timestamps
at least 2 overlapping growth intervals with compatible rates
preferably corroborating Peak/Mini values or shared instance identifier
